messages:
marie: quick sync on PR #5333  the disconnected install guide still shows IP-only /etc/hosts entries for KMS/HSM and QA said it reads like IPs are required. can we agree canonical wording and add SDK snippets for Go/Rust since customers asked?
oscar: canonical: prefer resolvable hostnames + TLS certs (CN or SAN matching hostname). /etc/hosts or IP SANs allowed only as bootstrap for fully air-gapped sites. mark the /etc/hosts example with a clear 'bootstrap only' label.
li: add secure curl example that validates certs when using /etc/hosts fallback, e.g. `curl --resolve "kms.internal:443:10.254.0.5" --cacert /etc/redwood/ca.pem https://kms.internal/health`. do NOT show `--insecure`.
greg: HSM notes: include vendor-agnostic PKCS#11 stub and recommend PIN via env or a local KMS-proxy. call out some HSMs expose management ports on a separate NIC; include firewall note. snippet to add:
```
pkcs11:
  library: /usr/lib/libpkcs11-vendor.so
  token: "hsm-token-01"
  slot: 0  # verify with vendor tool
  pin_env: HSM_PIN
```
marie: also add troubleshooting hairpin/NAT bullet: symptom = control-plane pods can't reach internal IPs due to SNAT; fix = enable NAT loopback/hairpin or use hostname resolution. mention MTU fragmentation on VPN tunnels as a separate bullet.
oscar: SDK asks: add Go and Rust examples showing env var keys and custom CA validation instead of inlining certs. proposed Go snippet:
```
// Go example
client := redwood.NewClient(&redwood.Config{APIKey: os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"), CAPath: "/etc/redwood/ca.pem"})
```
li: Rust snippet suggestion:
```
// Rust example using reqwest
let client = reqwest::blocking::Client::builder().add_root_certificate(reqwest::Certificate::from_pem(&fs::read("/etc/redwood/ca.pem")?)).build()?;
let resp = client.get("https://kms.internal/health").send()?;
```
marie: small docs housekeeping: a couple of anchors in the certs and networking chapters moved; link-bot found and replaced them in the branch, thanks. ci-bot: any build problems?
ci-bot: docs-ci: build succeeded for PR #5333 (:white_check_mark:)
li: LGTM once HSM mgmt NIC note is added and SDK snippets land. i'll do a quick pass after commits.
marie: perfect. changelog suggestion: "Disconnected install: clarified KMS/HSM addressing, cert CN/SAN rules; added Go/Rust SDK snippets, PKCS#11 example, and hairpin NAT/MTU troubleshooting."
oscar: merging after small tidy. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
